initial_request: Read venue-brief.md and create decision.json with selected_venue (string), attendees (integer), cost_usd (integer), capacity_margin (integer), constraints_met (array containing applicable codes step_free, indoor_rain_backup, open_through_19, cost_within_1200), rejected (object mapping each rejected venue to one decisive code: closes_early, stairs_only, or no_rain_backup), and unresolved (array of strings). Choose the lowest-cost qualifying venue. Do not invent availability or a booking. Explain the decision briefly in your final message.

source_before_task.venue-brief.md:
Choose one venue for 58 participants. Non-negotiable: step-free entry, an indoor rain backup, open through 19:00, and total venue cost no more than $1,200. Prefer the lowest-cost qualifying option.

| Venue | Capacity | Entry | Rain backup | Closes | Total cost |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Pine | 64 | Step-free | Indoor | 17:00 | $900 |
| Bay | 62 | Step-free | Indoor | 21:00 | $1,150 |
| Dock | 90 | Stairs only | Indoor | 22:00 | $800 |
| Elm | 60 | Step-free | None | 20:00 | $1,000 |

stages.public_final: Created [decision.json](<disposable>/workspace/decision.json). Bay is the only venue meeting all four constraints, at $1,150 for 58 attendees with a capacity margin of 4. The JSON parsed successfully, and I checked its required fields, constraints, and rejection codes. Availability remains unresolved; no booking was made.
